chapters.blurb: A Tamil empire of temples, bronze, trade and the sea — its rise, its emperors, its genius and its long sunset.

parts.part: I. Rise of the Tiger Throne

episodes.title: Taming the Kaveri: The Grand Anicut
episodes.era: Early Chola root, c. 2nd century CE
episodes.chapter_part: I. Rise of the Tiger Throne
episodes.legend: He chained a wild river and fed a future empire.

episodes.title: Vijayalaya Seizes Thanjavur
episodes.era: Rise of the Imperial Cholas, c. 850 CE
episodes.chapter_part: I. Rise of the Tiger Throne
episodes.legend: From one captured city, he lit the fire of an empire.

episodes.title: The Chola Village Chooses Its Guardians
episodes.era: Chola administration under Parantaka I, c. 919-921 CE
episodes.chapter_part: I. Rise of the Tiger Throne
episodes.legend: A village that carved its rules in stone, not in whispers.

episodes.title: Rajaraja Raises Brihadisvara
episodes.legend: He raised a stone mountain for god, art, and empire.

episodes.title: The Shadow of the Great Vimana
episodes.legend: He raised a stone mountain that time could not break.

episodes.title: Rajaraja's Sword: Kandalur to Lanka
episodes.legend: He forged the Chola realm into a true southern empire.

episodes.title: Kundavai, the Chola Princess
episodes.legend: She turned royal power into stone, song, and healing hands.

episodes.title: Rajendra Brings the Ganges South
episodes.legend: He brought the sacred Ganga’s water to his southern sea-washed throne.

episodes.title: Rajendra's Fleet to Srivijaya
episodes.era: Imperial Chola naval expedition, c. 1025 CE
episodes.legend: The king who hurled India’s war-banner across the eastern seas.

parts.part: IV. Craft, Trade & the Genius of the Age

episodes.figure: Chola bronze artisans and temple patrons
episodes.title: Chola Bronze Artists Make the Divine Dance
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Craft, Trade & the Genius of the Age
episodes.legend: They made metal move like a god in dance.

episodes.figure: Ainnurruvar/Manigramam merchant guilds and Chola-era trade
episodes.title: Tamil Merchant Guilds Sail the Indian Ocean
episodes.era: Chola-era Indian Ocean trade, 11th-13th century CE
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Craft, Trade & the Genius of the Age
episodes.legend: They sailed with goods, and ruled the seas with trust.

episodes.title: Kulottunga, the King Who Abolished Tolls
episodes.legend: He won his greatest name not in war, but in mercy.

episodes.title: Kamban Sings the Tamil Ramayana
episodes.era: Later Chola cultural age, c. 12th century CE
episodes.legend: He turned Ramayana into the heartbeat of Tamil words.

parts.part: I. The Rise of the Guptas

episodes.title: Chandragupta I and the Licchavi Bride
episodes.era: Founding of the Gupta empire, c. 319-335 CE
episodes.chapter_part: I. The Rise of the Guptas
episodes.legend: He turned a wedding into the birth of an empire.

episodes.title: Samudragupta's Hundred Victories
episodes.chapter_part: I. The Rise of the Guptas
episodes.legend: He carved his storm of victories into an ancient emperor’s stone.

episodes.title: Chandragupta II and the Fall of the Shakas
episodes.era: Gupta zenith, c. 375-415 CE (Shaka conquest c. 409 CE)
episodes.legend: He broke the Shaka chains and opened the western seas.

episodes.title: Prabhavatigupta, the Regent Queen
episodes.legend: A widowed queen who held two empires together.

episodes.title: Faxian's Road Through a Golden Land
episodes.era: Gupta zenith, the traveller's years c. 399-414 CE
episodes.legend: He walked half the world to save the Buddha’s words.

parts.part: III. The Age of Number, Iron and Healing

episodes.title: Aryabhata Turns the Earth
episodes.era: Gupta science, the Aryabhatiya composed 499 CE
episodes.chapter_part: III. The Age of Number, Iron and Healing
episodes.legend: He dared to say the Earth itself moves.

episodes.title: The Dot That Became Zero
episodes.era: The Indian journey of zero, Gupta age to 628 CE
episodes.chapter_part: III. The Age of Number, Iron and Healing
episodes.legend: He dared to give nothing its own number.

episodes.figure: The Master Smith of the Iron Pillar
episodes.title: The Iron Pillar That Would Not Rust
episodes.era: Gupta metallurgy, c. early 5th century CE
episodes.chapter_part: III. The Age of Number, Iron and Healing
episodes.legend: He forged a pillar that time and rain could not break.
epithets: Master Smith of the Iron Pillar

episodes.title: Sushruta and the Healer's Knife
episodes.era: The Gupta redaction of Ayurveda, c. 4th-5th century CE
episodes.chapter_part: III. The Age of Number, Iron and Healing
episodes.legend: He turned the knife of harm into a blade of mercy.

episodes.title: Nalanda, the Ocean of Learning
episodes.era: Founded under Kumaragupta I, c. 427 CE
episodes.legend: The king who planted a monastery and grew a world of minds.

episodes.title: Kalidasa and the Cloud Messenger
episodes.era: Classical Sanskrit's peak, c. late 4th-early 5th century CE
episodes.legend: His words made an empire of beauty that time could not break.

episodes.figure: The Master Sculptor of the Gupta Age
episodes.title: The Gods Take Shape at Deogarh
episodes.era: The classical moment of Indian art, 5th-early 6th century CE
episodes.legend: He gave stone a calm face the gods still wear.

episodes.title: Skandagupta Holds Back the Huns
episodes.legend: He stood between the golden age and the Huna storm.

parts.part: I. The Rise of the Peacock Throne

episodes.title: Chandragupta Raises the Peacock Standard
episodes.era: Founding of the Maurya Empire, c. 321-297 BCE
episodes.chapter_part: I. The Rise of the Peacock Throne
episodes.legend: From exile and hunger, he forges India’s first great empire.
epithets: Founding Emperor of the Maurya Empire

episodes.title: Kautilya's Manual of Spies and Kings
episodes.era: Mauryan statecraft tradition and later Arthashastra compilation
episodes.chapter_part: I. The Rise of the Peacock Throne
episodes.legend: The quiet mind that forged an empire in secret.

parts.part: II. The Empire Meets the World

episodes.title: Five Hundred Elephants for Seleucus
episodes.chapter_part: II. The Empire Meets the World
episodes.legend: He traded steel for peace and shook empires with elephants.

episodes.title: Megasthenes at the Wooden Capital
episodes.era: Greek embassy to Chandragupta's court, c. 300 BCE
episodes.chapter_part: II. The Empire Meets the World
episodes.legend: He crossed worlds to write the first Greek tale of India.

episodes.title: Bindusara's Figs Wine and Philosopher
episodes.era: The transitional Mauryan reign, c. 297-272 BCE
episodes.chapter_part: II. The Empire Meets the World
episodes.legend: The quiet king who held a vast empire together

episodes.title: Ashoka Appoints the Dhamma Officers
episodes.legend: The conqueror who turned his power toward mercy and care.

episodes.title: Prinsep Reads the Forgotten King
episodes.legend: He made a silent stone king speak again.
epithets: Scholar of the East India Company

episodes.title: The Four Lions of Sarnath
episodes.era: Ashokan pillar art, c. 250 BCE and modern national adoption in 1947-1950
episodes.legend: From war’s ashes, he carved stone to roar for justice.

episodes.title: Mahinda's Bodhi Sapling Voyage
episodes.era: Buddhist missions after the Third Council, c. 250-247 BCE
episodes.legend: They sailed with faith and a sapling, reshaping two lands forever.

episodes.title: The Echoing Caves for Ajivikas
episodes.era: Barabar and Nagarjuni cave dedications, c. 259-245 BCE and after
episodes.legend: They carved silent stone homes for another faith to breathe free.

episodes.title: The Didarganj Yakshi's Polished Secret
episodes.era: Early historic sculpture, debated Mauryan or Kushan date
episodes.legend: A shining stone beauty, guarding a mystery across two empires.

episodes.title: The Parade That Ended the Mauryas
episodes.era: End of the Maurya Empire, c. 185 BCE
episodes.legend: On a royal parade ground, one stroke ends an empire.

episodes.title: Chandragupta's Last Fast at Shravanabelagola
episodes.era: Digambara Jain tradition of Chandragupta's final years, after c. 297 BCE
episodes.legend: The empire-maker ends as a silent fasting monk.

parts.part: I. The City of Victory Rises

episodes.figure: Harihara I and Bukka Raya I
episodes.title: Harihara and Bukka Raise a City of Victory
episodes.era: Foundation of Vijayanagara, traditional date 1336 CE
episodes.chapter_part: I. The City of Victory Rises
episodes.legend: Two brothers raise Vijayanagara from rock, river and faith.

episodes.title: Hampi the Boulder Crowned Capital
episodes.era: Vijayanagara capital at its height, 14th-16th centuries CE
episodes.chapter_part: I. The City of Victory Rises
episodes.legend: Where granite hills guarded a shining empire of gods and kings.

episodes.figure: Kamalapura Tank and the Bukka Aqueduct
episodes.title: The Tanks That Fed an Empire
episodes.era: Vijayanagara hydraulic works, especially 15th-16th centuries CE
episodes.chapter_part: I. The City of Victory Rises
episodes.legend: Stone and water together kept a mighty empire alive.

parts.part: II. The Zenith of the Rayas

episodes.title: Krishnadevaraya Takes Raichur
episodes.era: Tuluva dynasty zenith and the Raichur campaign, 1520 CE
episodes.chapter_part: II. The Zenith of the Rayas
episodes.legend: He broke Raichur’s walls and lit new fires in the Deccan.

episodes.title: The King Who Wrote Amuktamalyada
episodes.chapter_part: II. The Zenith of the Rayas
episodes.legend: He ruled with the sword, but wrote with a lover’s heart.

episodes.title: The Stone Chariot and Singing Pillars
episodes.chapter_part: II. The Zenith of the Rayas
episodes.legend: Hands that turned hard granite into song, story and motion.

parts.part: III. Roads of Witness and Wealth

episodes.figure: Paes, Nunes, Abdur Razzaq and Nicolo de' Conti
episodes.title: Four Travelers Enter the City
episodes.chapter_part: III. Roads of Witness and Wealth
episodes.legend: They saw the city of victory and counted its wonders.
epithets: Foreign Eyes of the City of Victory

episodes.title: Diamonds Horses and Pagodas in the Bazaar
episodes.chapter_part: III. Roads of Witness and Wealth
episodes.legend: They turned temple streets into a gateway to the world.

episodes.title: The Nayakas Who Held the Sword
episodes.era: Vijayanagara administration and army, 14th-16th centuries CE
episodes.chapter_part: III. Roads of Witness and Wealth
episodes.legend: They held the king’s sword, then carved their own thrones.

parts.part: IV. Songs, Wit and Shattered Walls

episodes.title: Rakkasa Tangadi Breaks the Capital
episodes.era: Battle of Talikota or Rakkasa-Tangadi, January 1565 CE
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Songs, Wit and Shattered Walls
episodes.legend: He rose as kingmaker and fell in one brutal afternoon.

episodes.title: Purandara Dasa Sets the First Notes
episodes.era: Haridasa bhakti and Carnatic music, c. 1484-1564 CE
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Songs, Wit and Shattered Walls
episodes.legend: He turned God’s praise into the first lessons of music.

episodes.title: Tenali Rama Between Poet and Folktale
episodes.era: Krishnadevaraya's court and later folklore, c. 1480-1528 CE and after
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Songs, Wit and Shattered Walls
episodes.legend: A real court poet, reborn as India’s beloved trickster legend.

episodes.title: Hampi Becomes a World Heritage Memory
episodes.era: Aravidu afterlife and modern heritage, 1570-1646 CE and 1986 onward
episodes.legend: When the city died, its spirit marched on with them.

episodes.title: The Village That Began Everything
episodes.era: Neolithic and Chalcolithic Mehrgarh, c. 7000-3300 BCE
episodes.legend: Before cities rose, their quiet fields changed everything.

episodes.title: The City That Drew Itself in Straight Lines
episodes.era: Early to Mature Harappan urban transition, c. 2700-1900 BCE
episodes.legend: They drew a whole world in brick, water, and straight lines.

episodes.title: The Invisible Government of Harappa
episodes.era: Mature Harappan civic organisation, c. 2600-1900 BCE
episodes.legend: They ruled a vast land without crowns, palaces, or kings.
epithets: Masters of the Great Bath and Granaries

episodes.title: The Pool at the Heart of the City
episodes.legend: They carved a shared heart of water into the city’s brick soul.

episodes.title: The City That Did Not Smell
episodes.era: Mature Harappan sanitation systems, c. 2600-1900 BCE
episodes.legend: They kept a whole civilization from rotting in its own waste.

episodes.title: Water in the Desert
episodes.legend: They trapped the monsoon so a desert city could breathe.

episodes.title: The Bead That Crossed the World
episodes.era: Mature Harappan craft production and export, c. 2600-1900 BCE
episodes.legend: They turned stone to fire-bright beads that crossed the world.

episodes.title: The Same Weight from Harappa to Shortughai
episodes.legend: Across cities and deserts, their tiny stones made trade honest.

episodes.title: The Ships of Meluhha
episodes.legend: From silent seals, their ships still cross the western seas.

episodes.title: The One-Horned Bull and the Mark of the Maker
episodes.era: Mature Harappan seals and administration, c. 2600-1900 BCE
episodes.legend: Their tiny seals carried a vast world of trust and power.

episodes.title: Four Thousand Signs and Silence
episodes.era: Harappan script use, c. 2600-1900 BCE, and decipherment debates to the present
episodes.legend: They chase lost words that may never speak back.

episodes.title: A Face in Stone a Body in Bronze
episodes.era: Mohenjo-daro sculpture and Harappan iconography, c. 2500-1900 BCE
episodes.legend: They shaped a lost city’s face, but not its true name.

episodes.title: When the Monsoons Changed
episodes.era: Harappan decline and genetic evidence, c. 2200-1300 BCE
episodes.legend: When the rains faded, her people changed shape, not soul.

episodes.title: Babur's Thunder at Panipat
episodes.legend: On Panipat’s dust, cannon thunder births a new empire.

episodes.title: The Princess Who Wrote History
episodes.legend: She turned a princess’s memory into the empire’s living heart.

episodes.title: The City Akbar Built and Left
episodes.era: Fatehpur Sikri as imperial capital, c. 1571-1585
episodes.legend: He dared to build an empire’s heart from sacred desert dust.

episodes.title: The Mansab Opens the Gate
episodes.legend: He measured power, bound pride, and forged one obedient sword.

episodes.title: Todar Mal Counts Every Bigha
episodes.legend: He counted every field so justice could count every farmer.

episodes.figure: Mir Sayyid Ali and Abdus Samad
episodes.title: The Giant Book of Heroes
episodes.legend: They stitched a new empire’s dream in paint and cloth.

episodes.title: Jahangir Watches the Birds
episodes.legend: He turned royal wonder into pictures that time could not erase.

episodes.title: Nur Jahan's Name on Gold
episodes.legend: She dared to stamp a woman's name on the empire’s gold.

episodes.title: The Mausoleum at the Yamuna
episodes.legend: A love so deep it turned white stone into living memory.

episodes.title: The Prince Who Read the Hidden Books
episodes.legend: He risked a throne to read the soul of many faiths.

episodes.title: Samugarh and the Empty Elephant
episodes.legend: One empty elephant broke a prince and made an emperor.

parts.part: V. The Vast and Broken Realm

episodes.figure: Virji Vora and the Surat merchants
episodes.title: The Port That Fed an Empire
episodes.chapter_part: V. The Vast and Broken Realm
episodes.legend: He fed empires with ledgers, not swords.

episodes.title: Aurangzeb's Last Tent in the Deccan
episodes.chapter_part: V. The Vast and Broken Realm
episodes.legend: He took the Deccan, and lost the peace of his throne.

episodes.title: Pulakeshin I Builds the Red Rock Fort
episodes.legend: He carved a future empire into the red rock of Vatapi.

episodes.title: Mangalesa Lets the Rock Speak Kannada
episodes.legend: In Cave 3 at Badami, royal gifts and sacred images turn sandstone into one of the Deccan's earliest dated voices in Kannada.

episodes.title: Pulakeshin II Holds the Narmada Line
episodes.legend: When Harsha's northern power presses south, Pulakeshin II makes the Narmada a frontier that even court poets remember with a pun.

episodes.title: Vikramaditya II Spares Kanchi's Shrines
episodes.era: Late Badami Chalukya campaigns, c. 731-740 CE
episodes.legend: After entering Kanchipuram, Vikramaditya II leaves a rare boast not of plunder, but of protecting the conquered city's temples.

episodes.title: Dantidurga Steps Through the Golden Womb
episodes.legend: A Chalukya feudatory defeats his overlord, then uses the Hiranyagarbha ritual to be publicly reborn as a Rashtrakuta king.

episodes.title: Badami's Four Caves Test Sacred Art
episodes.era: Early Chalukya rock-cut art, c. 570-700 CE
episodes.legend: Across four caves, Chalukya workshops try Shiva, Vishnu and Jain images in sandstone, creating a living laboratory of Deccan sacred art.

episodes.title: Lokamahadevi Builds in Two Stone Tongues
episodes.legend: At Pattadakal, Queen Lokamahadevi sponsors Virupaksha temple, where northern and southern architectural forms meet in one royal masterpiece.

episodes.title: Krishna I Carves Kailasa Downward
episodes.legend: Instead of stacking stone upward, Krishna I's craftsmen cut a mountain from the top down until Kailasa temple stands free inside the rock.

parts.part: IV. Copper, Roads and World Trade

episodes.title: The Boar Seal Grants a Village
episodes.era: Early medieval Deccan governance, c. 566-681 CE
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Copper, Roads and World Trade
episodes.legend: A copper plate sealed with the Chalukya boar records fields, taxes, witnesses and warnings, turning royal command into written land law.

episodes.title: Govinda III Rides Toward Kanauj
episodes.era: Rashtrakuta northern campaign and Tripartite Struggle, c. 800-808 CE
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Copper, Roads and World Trade
episodes.legend: From the Deccan, Govinda III rides into the northern contest for Kanauj, where Palas, Pratiharas and Rashtrakutas chase one throne's prestige.

episodes.title: Arab Merchants Praise Manyakheta
episodes.chapter_part: IV. Copper, Roads and World Trade
episodes.legend: Arab writers call the Balhara one of the world's great kings and reveal a Deccan open to horses, textiles, ports and merchant communities.

episodes.title: Amoghavarsha Opens Kannada's Royal Path
episodes.legend: In Amoghavarsha's court, Kavirajamarga maps a country of poets and gives Kannada literature a royal path beside Sanskrit learning.

episodes.title: Mahaviracharya Counts the World
episodes.legend: Mahaviracharya gathers rules for fractions, measures, shadows and combinations into a dedicated mathematics book for a practical world.

episodes.title: Lakhbaksh Starts the Tower of Delhi
episodes.legend: A Turkic slave-general breaks from the Ghurids, rules from Delhi and Lahore, and begins the sandstone tower that still marks the first Sultanate horizon.

episodes.title: Iltutmish Wins a Throne and a Caliph
episodes.legend: Iltutmish turns a fragile conquest into a recognized sultanate with coins, iqta grants, a caliphal diploma, and a daughter he dares to name heir.

episodes.title: Razia Sultan Rides Through the Gate
episodes.legend: Her coins call her Sultan, and for four fierce years Razia governs in her own name while nobles fear the woman they cannot control.

episodes.title: Balban Builds the Shadow of God
episodes.legend: A former slave turns kingship into ceremony, spies on governors, breaks the Forty, and loses his heir defending Delhi from the Mongol storm.

episodes.title: Malik Kafur Marches Beyond the Vindhyas
episodes.legend: Bought for a thousand dinars, Malik Kafur leads Alauddin's armies across the Deccan and returns with tribute that changes Delhi's imagination of India.

episodes.title: Alauddin Holds Siri Against the Mongols
episodes.era: Khalji wars with the Mongols, 1297-1306 CE
episodes.legend: Five times the Mongols press toward Delhi, and Alauddin answers with forts, armies, hard discipline, and the city of Siri.

episodes.title: Muhammad bin Tughlaq Tests the Impossible
episodes.legend: A brilliant sultan moves a capital, issues token coins, dreams across mountains, and leaves Ibn Battuta amazed by genius and terror in the same court.

episodes.title: Timur Leaves Delhi Empty
episodes.era: Timurid invasion of north India, 1398-1399 CE
episodes.legend: Timur storms into a weakened Sultanate, sacks Delhi in December 1398, and marches away with treasure, captives and artisans for Samarkand.

episodes.title: Stone Speaks at the Qutb Complex
episodes.era: Qutb Complex building phases, c. 1193-1368 CE
episodes.legend: Across 170 years, masons, calligraphers and sultans turn reused columns, true arches, domes and repairs into the first great archive of Sultanate stone.

episodes.title: Alauddin Fixes the Price of Wheat
episodes.legend: After siege hunger frightens Delhi, Alauddin fixes prices, licenses traders, fills granaries and posts spies so an enormous army can eat cheaply.

episodes.title: Firuz Shah Turns Water into Villages
episodes.legend: Firuz Shah digs canals, restores tanks, founds villages, moves Ashokan pillars, and writes a memoir that lists both welfare works and hard-edged intolerance.

parts.part: V. Words, Song and the Open Door

episodes.title: Amir Khusrau Sings Hind and Iran
episodes.chapter_part: V. Words, Song and the Open Door
episodes.legend: Serving eight sultans and loving one saint, Amir Khusrau writes Persian for courts, Hindavi for the street, and songs that still echo at Nizamuddin.

episodes.title: Nizamuddin Opens the Khanqah Door
episodes.chapter_part: V. Words, Song and the Open Door
episodes.legend: While sultans summon and threaten, Nizamuddin Auliya keeps his khanqah open to the poor, the stranger and the singer at the edge of Delhi.

periods.label: Ancient India
periods.blurb: Empires, dharma and the classical age

episodes.title: Porus at the River Hydaspes
episodes.legend: He lost the battle, not his crown of dignity.

episodes.title: Ashoka's Kalinga Change of Heart
episodes.legend: The conqueror who saw the blood, and chose mercy instead.

episodes.title: Abbakka's Refusal at Ullal
episodes.era: Coastal resistance to Portuguese expansion, 16th century
episodes.legend: She faced an empire’s fleet and refused to bow.
epithets: Warrior Queen of the Western Coast

episodes.title: Shivaji's Quiet Escape from Agra
episodes.legend: The king who slipped from Agra and lit a free Deccan.

periods.label: The Freedom Struggle
periods.blurb: Revolt, resistance and a free India

episodes.title: Rani Lakshmibai's Stand at Kotah-ki-Serai
episodes.legend: She rode into cannon fire so her people would not kneel.

episodes.title: Mangal Pandey at Barrackpore
episodes.legend: On a dusty parade ground, one sepoy dared to say no.
epithets: Sepoy of the 34th Bengal Native Infantry

episodes.title: Bahadur Shah Zafar and the Red Fort Call
episodes.legend: An old poet-emperor becomes the last fragile banner of freedom.

episodes.title: Kunwar Singh Returns to Jagdispur
episodes.legend: An old lion marches home, sword bright, spirit unbowed.

episodes.title: Tatya Tope's Long March
episodes.legend: The rebel general who turned defeat into a long, burning march.

episodes.title: Tilak Speaks in Court
episodes.legend: He turned a sedition trial into a cry for swaraj.

episodes.title: Khudiram Bose's Young Resolve
episodes.legend: A teenage boy walked smiling to the gallows for freedom.
epithets: Youngest martyr of Indian freedom struggle

episodes.title: Bagha Jatin by the Buribalam
episodes.era: Revolutionary nationalism during World War I, 1915
episodes.legend: By the Buribalam, he chose duty, not escape.

episodes.figure: Ashfaqulla Khan and Ram Prasad Bismil
episodes.title: The Kakori Promise
episodes.legend: Two friends, one noose, one unbroken dream of freedom.

episodes.title: Lala Lajpat Rai Faces the Simon Commission
episodes.legend: He walked unarmed into lathis so a nation could stand tall.

episodes.title: Bhagat Singh Makes the Deaf Hear
episodes.legend: In the Central Legislative Assembly, Bhagat Singh and B. K. Dutt chose a dramatic protest meant to make a message heard rather than to harm bystanders. In court, Singh used clear words to explain why ideas cannot be locked away.
